files.content:
[meta]
title = "Twitchイベント通知（チャット・画面）"
description = "個人名や報酬IDを持たない通知構成。OAuthは保存済みtoken keyから取得。"

[[nodes]]
id = "eventsub"
feature = "flowgraph.ingress.twitch_eventsub"
position = [80, 80]
[nodes.properties]
token_key = "broadcaster"
event_types = ["channel.channel_points_custom_reward_redemption.add", "channel.follow", "channel.subscribe", "channel.subscription.message", "channel.subscription.gift", "channel.raid"]

id = "notice"
feature = "flowgraph.twitch.event_notice"
position = [500, 80]

templates.description: 自然なAI会話、字幕、音声、アバター反応を準備する構成

files.content:
# AI共演者の発話確定片を字幕へ先行表示し、確定全文で収束させつつTTSへ流す標準出力。
# AI設定GUIがturn_managementとstreamを有効化し、ai.speechを生成する前提。

[meta]
title = "AI companion output"
description = "AI発話をai-synthへ先行表示して確定全文へ収束させ、自然な区切りの発話片をOS TTSで再生する。"
tags = ["starter", "ai", "subtitle", "tts"]

[[nodes]]
id = "subtitle_in"
feature = "flowgraph.ingress.ai_response"
position = [80, 120]

[[nodes]]
id = "speech_in"
feature = "flowgraph.ingress.ai_speech"
position = [80, 360]

[[nodes]]
id = "subtitle_channel"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [320, 40]
properties.value = "ai-synth"

[[nodes]]
id = "subtitle_emit"
feature = "flowgraph.bos.output"
position = [560, 120]

[[nodes]]
id = "live_subtitle_emit"
feature = "flowgraph.bos.output"
position = [560, 240]

[[nodes]]
id = "tts_engine"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [320, 300]
properties.value = "os"

[[nodes]]
id = "tts_voice"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [320, 380]
properties.value = ""

[[nodes]]
id = "tts_lane"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [320, 460]
properties.value = "assistant"

[[nodes]]
id = "tts_non_blocking"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.bool"
position = [320, 540]
properties.value = true

[[nodes]]
id = "speak"
feature = "flowgraph.tts.speak"
position = [560, 360]

[[nodes]]
id = "log_error"
feature = "flowgraph.util.log"
position = [840, 440]

[[edges]]
from = "subtitle_in:exec_out"
to = "subtitle_emit:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "subtitle_in:content"
to = "subtitle_emit:content"

[[edges]]
from = "subtitle_channel:value"
to = "subtitle_emit:destination"

[[edges]]
from = "speech_in:exec_out"
to = "live_subtitle_emit:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "speech_in:utterance_content"
to = "live_subtitle_emit:content"

[[edges]]
from = "speech_in:meta"
to = "live_subtitle_emit:meta"

[[edges]]
from = "subtitle_channel:value"
to = "live_subtitle_emit:destination"

[[edges]]
from = "speech_in:exec_out"
to = "speak:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "speech_in:content"
to = "speak:text"

[[edges]]
from = "tts_engine:value"
to = "speak:engine"

[[edges]]
from = "tts_voice:value"
to = "speak:voice"

[[edges]]
from = "tts_lane:value"
to = "speak:lane"

[[edges]]
from = "tts_non_blocking:value"
to = "speak:non_blocking"

[[edges]]
from = "speak:on_error"
to = "log_error:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "speak:error"
to = "log_error:value"

# 配信AI用 AvatarIntent -> 時系列UNMF/Z出力。
# 初期状態はdry-run。AI設定でUNAvatar Rendererの受信keyと実出力を明示する。

[meta]
title = "AI avatar reaction output"
description = "AvatarIntentを時間サンプル列へ展開し、neutral復帰までUNMF/Zへ出力する。"
tags = ["starter", "avatar", "ai", "unmf", "unmfz"]

[[nodes]]
id = "avatar_intent_in"
feature = "flowgraph.ingress.ai_avatar_intent"
position = [80, 100]

[[nodes]]
id = "parse_intent"
feature = "flowgraph.json.parse"
position = [320, 100]

[[nodes]]
id = "play_intent"
feature = "flowgraph.avatar.intent_play_unmfz"
position = [600, 100]

[[nodes]]
id = "unmfz_base_key"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [600, 360]
properties.value = "un-motion/frame/ai-avatar"

[[nodes]]
id = "unmfz_topic_mode"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.string"
position = [600, 440]
properties.value = "frame"

[[nodes]]
id = "unmfz_schema_major"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.int"
position = [600, 520]
properties.value = 1

[[nodes]]
id = "dry_run"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.bool"
position = [600, 600]
properties.value = true

[[nodes]]
id = "playback_fps"
feature = "flowgraph.literal.int"
position = [600, 680]
properties.value = 30

[[nodes]]
id = "log_key"
feature = "flowgraph.util.log"
position = [1000, 100]

[[nodes]]
id = "log_error"
feature = "flowgraph.util.log"
position = [1000, 240]

[[edges]]
from = "avatar_intent_in:exec_out"
to = "play_intent:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "avatar_intent_in:content"
to = "parse_intent:text"

[[edges]]
from = "parse_intent:value"
to = "play_intent:intent"

[[edges]]
from = "unmfz_base_key:value"
to = "play_intent:base_key_expr"

[[edges]]
from = "unmfz_topic_mode:value"
to = "play_intent:topic_mode"

[[edges]]
from = "unmfz_schema_major:value"
to = "play_intent:schema_major"

[[edges]]
from = "dry_run:value"
to = "play_intent:dry_run"

[[edges]]
from = "playback_fps:value"
to = "play_intent:fps"

[[edges]]
from = "play_intent:on_success"
to = "log_key:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "play_intent:key_expr"
to = "log_key:value"

[[edges]]
from = "play_intent:on_error"
to = "log_error:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "play_intent:error"
to = "log_error:value"

[meta]
title = "入力回数カウンター"
description = "Web入力ごとに1を加え、現在の回数を実行トレースへ出力します。再読込すると0に戻ります。"
tags = ["counter", "starter"]

[[nodes]]
id = "in"
feature = "flowgraph.ingress.web_input"
position = [80, 80]

[[nodes]]
id = "counter"
feature = "flowgraph.state.int_counter"
position = [500, 80]

[[nodes]]
id = "text"
feature = "flowgraph.convert.int_to_string"
position = [920, 80]

[[nodes]]
id = "count_log"
feature = "flowgraph.util.log"
position = [1340, 80]

[[edges]]
from = "in:exec_out"
to = "counter:increment"

[[edges]]
from = "counter:value"
to = "text:value"

[[edges]]
from = "counter:changed"
to = "count_log:exec_in"

[[edges]]
from = "text:result"
to = "count_log:value"
